confidence_notes: Food and drink anchors are medium confidence. They rely on crowd-sourced and aggregator figures (Numbeo, CityCost, My Life Elsewhere, Bear Savings, Wise) that disagree with each other, converted at about R$5.3 per USD, the rate implied by those sources. Cocktail and wine are inferred from the beer anchor (about 3x and 2x beer) because no direct local price was found. Accommodation is a holistic model estimate for July high season, made without any accommodation search, so it is low confidence. The FX value (0.6720 for 2026-11-18) came from a secondary summary that cites the RBA print. The rba.gov.au page itself was not read, so verify against the F11.1 table.
comparable_city_reasoning: No single comparable city was used. Food and drink anchors are based on Brazilian national and tourist-city price indicators. Accommodation is a judgement based on mid-sized Latin American tourist cities, adjusted for July high season near Iguazu Falls.
